metadata.description: Agent skills for Go development, Elasticsearch, and Postgres best practices

plugins.name: golang-best-practices
plugins.description: Idiomatic Go patterns, best practices, and conventions for building robust, efficient, and maintainable Go applications. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing Go code, designing packages, writing tests, or benchmarking performance.

plugins.name: elasticsearch-best-practices
plugins.description: Elasticsearch development best practices for indexing, querying, mapping, and search optimization. Use when designing indices, writing queries, configuring analyzers, or optimizing Elasticsearch cluster performance.

plugins.name: postgres-best-practices
plugins.description: Postgres performance optimization and best practices from Supabase. Use when writing, reviewing, or optimizing Postgres queries, schema designs, or database configurations.

plugins.name: agent-instructions-setup
plugins.description: AI coding agent instruction file setup and management. Configures AGENTS.md as single source of truth and creates symlinks for tool-specific files. Use when initializing a new project for AI-assisted development or unifying configuration across multiple AI coding tools.

plugins.name: programming-principles
plugins.description: Programming principles and philosophy based on Rob Pike's 5 Rules of Programming. Use when making optimization decisions, choosing between simple and complex algorithms, designing data structures, or evaluating performance tuning approaches.
